prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='DWT_rf', seasonality_champion='NaiveSeasonal', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: DWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while NaiveSeasonal best captures seasonality (0.33). NaiveMovingAverage leads overall RMSE (24.38) but rankings are highly unstable (Kendall τ=-0.05) with significant model disagreement (spread ratio 0.96), warranting robust median/trimmed-mean combination over stacking.
